codeReview.summary: The fix closes both blocking issues from the prior review. Missing subscription tier metadata now fails closed with a structured 400 payload instead of surfacing as an HTTP 500 through quality/start preflight, and repeated start requests now short-circuit through authoritative runtime status before prerequisite or quota validation noise. The added regressions cover the HTTP quality route, direct quota-backed audio quality evaluation, and already-running start ordering on the managed-runtime path.
